notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5821 and PB5825 landed; kb/Work PB5878): the mode tier selects on FileConnector.UseModeView, the mode the file IS open in (FileConnector.OpenedModeView) when the unit has a procedure for it, else the mode an OPEN attempts (FileConnector.OpenModeView, PB5200). So an OPEN INPUT of a file open OUTPUT or EXTEND that fails '41' runs the OUTPUT or EXTEND procedure (GR6c/e: 'open in the output mode'), an OPEN whose attempted mode alone has a procedure runs that one, and where both modes have one the text names no order and the procedure of the mode the file is open in runs, as GnuCOBOL's does (CLAUDE.md rule 1; docs/conformance determination D-USE-OPEN-MODE-BOTH; witnessed by pb5878_use_both_modes_open_mode_runs at 85, 2014, 2023). The globalOnly tier excepts the files the container's non-GLOBAL USE statements name (PB5821). The WHEN EXCEPTION open-mode arm (ControlFlowEmitter.EmitMatcherArms) reads both views.
